D-001: Grid unit U = 8 world px; world units = canvas px at zoom 1; x/y/w integers multiples of 8; h integer, measured heights rounded UP to a multiple of 8.
D-002: Viewport affine {tx, ty, k}, screen = world*k + t, k in [0.1, 3]; new project viewport {tx:80, ty:80, k:1}.
D-003: Zoom about cursor; ctrl/meta wheel (pinch) k*exp(-deltaY*0.0025); plain wheel pans; +/- keys step x1.2 about stage centre.
D-004: fit(): pad 80 screen px, k clamped [0.1, 1.25]; key 1 fit all, Shift+1 fit selection, 0 = 100%; phone initial fit with k >= 0.35.
D-005: Wheel deltaMode normalised (mode1 x16, mode2 x viewport height); wheel/pointermove passive:false only on the stage element.
D-006: Snap threshold 6 screen px (6/k world); guides beat grid; smallest guide distance wins; x and y independent; Shift disables snapping for the gesture.
D-007: Snap neighbours: live, visible, non-hidden, non-stacked blocks within viewport +400 world px, excluding the move set, cap 200 nearest; frames add inner edges inset 16; resize snaps only dragged edges, no centres.
D-008: Drag threshold 4 screen px; double-click timing 350 ms.
D-009: Grid drawn in screen space on the stage (background-image); step 64/32/8 world px for k<0.5 / k<1.5 / else; dot radius 1 screen px; alpha clamp((k-0.25)/0.25,0,1); hidden when G off.
D-010: Culling: mount blocks intersecting viewport +400 world px each side; culled rows still feed snapping; below k<0.3 blocks render as chips (dot + first line).
D-011: Object classes: paper (padding 16, radius 12, cardBg), paperless (anchor, heading, divider, since, frame), media (padding 0, radius 10, caption inset 16). Rectangles only; no rotation, no free fonts, no per-block colour.
D-012: Auto-height types (E/W + corners change width only): concept, since, update, timeline, draft, anchor, note, reference, commitment, compass, heading, recording, palette, image. Fixed both (8 handles): frame, gallery. Divider: fixed h 8, width only.
D-013: Default sizes (w x h): concept 1008x160, since 1008x40, update 320x96, timeline 320x240, draft 320x136, anchor 664x88, note 320x96, reference 320x112, commitment 320x64, compass 320x200, frame 512x384, heading 384x48, divider 256x8, image 320x(320/aspect), gallery 664x400, recording 320x120, palette 320x96.
D-014: Min/max widths: concept 480-1200, update 224-512, timeline 288-512, draft 256-448, anchor 192-1008, note 160-640, reference 192-512, commitment 224-512, compass 224-384, frame min 128x96, heading 128-1008, divider 64-1920, image 96-1200 aspect-locked, gallery min 192x144, recording 256-448, palette 192-640.
D-015: Measured height only via ResizeObserver on inner content (rAF-throttled, ignored during drag/resize, disconnected when culled), written to store.h and persisted; never read offsetHeight in a pointer handler.
D-016: Text blocks never scroll or clip on the canvas; they grow. Only the timeline folds (6 newest rows + 'n more').
D-017: Library click creates at the snapped stage centre; drag at the snapped drop point; placed_by 'person', arrival_state 'placed' unless auto_layout (D-064) composes it.
D-018: z integer unique per project, max+1 on create; render order (depth, z); NO bring-to-front on click/drag; Cmd+]/[ step, Shift = front/back; layers drag reassigns contiguous z as one command.
D-019: Frames hold children by parent_id with ABSOLUTE child coordinates; depth <= 2; enforced by DB trigger and frames.ts.
D-020: Reparent on drop: deepest live unlocked non-collapsed frame whose inner rect (inset 16) contains the primary block's centre; ties by higher z; frame grows to contain + 16 (same command); dragging out clears the parent.
D-021: Frame bar 48 px; collapse sets collapsed=true, content.expanded_h=h, h=48; children hidden-by-ancestor (computed); deleting a frame reparents children to null in place.
D-022: F wraps the selection in a new frame = union bbox + 24 each side; children reparented; frame placed_by 'person'.
D-023: Links: straight 1 px hairline (textPrimary @0.35) between nearest edge midpoints, non-scaling stroke, world-space SVG, 8 px gap from edges, optional word <= 24 chars on a ground chip at midpoint; unique per (from,to); never leave a project; hover tide + x deletes.
D-024: Link mode: L or context bar; first click from, second to, then word popover (Enter saves, Esc no word); Esc leaves the mode.
D-025: Selection = Set of ids, primary = last added; marquee by intersection, frame fully inside selected without its descendants; multi = one dashed tide union outline, no handles, no multi-resize; Cmd+A = unlocked, unhidden, top-level.
D-026: Since block never selectable/draggable; pinned at x=concept.x, w=concept.w, y=concept.y+concept.h+8; concept's move set always includes it. Concept/since/compass refuse delete and duplicate. Locked selectable only from layers; hidden never renders.
D-027: In-place editing uses plain auto-growing textareas (never Tiptap/contentEditable inside the scaled world); Tiptap only in the unscaled draft studio; double-click or Enter edits; blur or Esc commits.
D-028: Interactive elements inside blocks carry data-no-drag; the pointer machine ignores pointerdown inside [data-no-drag] and inside the editing block.
D-029: Undo stack cap 200, session-only; Commands expose apply/revert/patch; autosave consumes patches; coalesce same key within 500 ms (move/nudge/resize); one command per edit session; viewport never in the stack; deletes are soft.
D-030: Autosave: dirty ids flushed as FULL rows (never partial), debounce 600 ms / maxWait 3000 ms, chunks of <= 40 rows, keepalive fetch on pagehide and visibilitychange hidden (< 64 KB per chunk), retries 1s/3s/9s then 30s; save word saved/saving/unsaved; 401 -> 'sign in again'.
D-031: Two tabs: last write wins per row; canvas_version bumped once per batch by the route; poll GET since every 60 s while visible and on visible; refetch+merge newer rows when version differs and dirty is empty (skip the move set); flush first if dirty.
D-032: since window: studio_open_project rotates opened_before_at <- last_opened_at only when last_opened_at is older than 30 min, then sets last_opened_at=now; sentence derived deterministically from studio_since(), no model call.
D-033: placed_by auto|person: 'person' = dragged, resized, nudged, placed-by-drag, created at a point, framed, or z-reordered; tidy never moves person blocks. arrival_state placed|unplaced; unplaced = arrived from talk, not yet placed/dismissed.
D-034: Tidy (T): obstacles = person-placed + frames + descendants + unplaced + locked; movable = live top-level auto placed; compose around obstacles; one TidyCommand; 320 ms transition via a class for that commit only; fit(all) if a moved block left the viewport. Shift+T tidy everything (confirm) moves person blocks and sets them auto.
D-035: Update stacking: >= 8 placed single updates at tidy -> all but the 3 newest get stacked_in = timeline (existing, else new at the oldest's rect); stacked rows keep identity, are not rendered/snapped/selected individually; drag a row out or 'unstack' clears stacked_in and places by hand.
D-036: Edge arrival: column x = snap8(bbox(settled).maxX + 48); y from since.bottom+24 (or bbox top), stacking below the last unplaced +24; new column +344 to the right when the column would exceed bbox.bottom + 384; computed server-side at insert and stored (one truth).
D-037: Place button: arrival_state placed, placed_by stays auto, composed into its region while auto_layout else stays; place by drag: placed + person; dismiss: soft delete (undoable), talk entry keeps the words.
D-038: Off-screen arrivals show a tide pill '2 arrived ->' at the stage's right edge; click pans to the column.
D-039: phoneMode = innerWidth < 720 || (pointer: coarse && innerWidth < 740); re-evaluated on resize; iPads stay in builder mode.
D-040: Phone = same Stage with interactive=false: one finger pans, two pinch, tap -> bottom sheet (100 dvh, radius 22); no docks/handles/marquee/keyboard; since line fixed at top; talk bar fixed at bottom; arrivals show dismiss only + one line 'place it from a larger screen'.
D-041: Keys: arrows nudge 8 (Shift 40); Delete/Backspace soft delete; Cmd/Ctrl+D duplicate (+16,+16); Cmd/Ctrl+Z undo; Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Z and Cmd/Ctrl+Y redo; Cmd/Ctrl+A select all; Esc (leave mode > commit edit > deselect > close drawer); 1 fit; Shift+1 fit selection; 0 100%; +/- zoom; Space+drag pan; S snap; X sizes; G grid; T tidy; Shift+T tidy everything; L link; F frame; Enter edit/open; Cmd/Ctrl+]/[ z (Shift front/back); Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+H hide; Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+L lock; Cmd/Ctrl+K talk; / library search; ? key map. No strike key.
D-042: Selection tide 1 px outline drawn 1 px outside the rect in the screen-space overlay (x+0.5); handles 8x8 squares, fill cardBg, 1 px tide border, radius 0, 16x16 hit; hover 1 px hairline textPrimary@0.14; marquee 1 px dashed tide, fill tide@0.08.
D-043: Ember = the system's pencil only (guides, distance labels, strike line, catch marker). Tide = selection and arrival marker (8 px dot at -4,-4 with slow pulse). Type accents only: verdant commitment checkbox, violet draft dot, ochre anchor rule. Everything else ink on paper.
D-044: Ground: the stage is the container layer (containerBg bone #ece8de / coal #161412) under a constant 48 px ink top bar with Atmosphere neutral intensity 0.5 behind (paused during drag); chrome never toggles with theme, ground and paper do.
D-045: Chrome geometry: top bar 48; left rail 48 + 280 panel; right rail 48 + 320 panel; drawer 420 (draft 760, wider -> 100%); context bar 32 tall, 8 px above selection; zoom pill 28 bottom-left; talk pill 44 bottom-right. Panels rgba(13,12,11,0.74) + blur(18px) saturate(1.1), 1 px shell.line, radius 16. Drawers containerBg, 1 px left edge, canvas undimmed and pannable, swap in place.
D-046: Radii: paper block 12, frame 16, panel 16, media 10, gallery tile 8, swatch 6, context bar 10, handle 0. Shadows none at rest/hover; 0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.45) while dragging only; no scale on hover or drag.
D-047: Icons lucide-react 16 px stroke 1.5; hover translateY(-1px) + opacity .7->1 over 150 ms; nothing else animates on hover.
D-048: All UI text lowercase plain names: the shelf, talk, direction talk, compass, since you were here, tidy, tidy everything, place, dismiss, strike, unstrike, link, frame, layers, library. Type words uppercase mono only in eyebrows.
D-049: Never shown: word counts, talk counts, streaks, badges, tab counters, completion %, 'n days since', performance numbers. Only numbers: dates, resting days left, grid sizes (X), n arrived, n waiting, counts inside the compass.
D-050: One migration studio/supabase/migrations/001_studio_foundation.sql; 11 tables; RLS for all using (auth.uid() = user_id) with check (auth.uid() = user_id); user_id denormalised on every row.
D-051: The main app's portrait_entries is READ ONLY by the studio (lib/portrait-read.ts: getActivePortrait + formatPortraitForPrompt); the studio never writes to it, adds no enum value, creates no second portrait table.
D-052: Commitments are compass entries kind 'commitment' (asked_at, ask_count, resolution, resolved_at); block content {entry_id}. Proposed by talk -> pending AND block arrives at the edge at once; place = confirm (active); dismiss = reject; drawer confirm activates without moving; drawer reject soft-deletes the block. Only active unresolved commitments are asked about.
D-053: Compass block is read-only on canvas (counts, first statements, 'n waiting'); confirm/correct/reject/forget and catch marks live only in the compass drawer (desktop) / sheet (phone).
D-054: Talk = one request, one stream: MODELS.deep reply streamed; MODELS.fast sort started concurrently; copied streamClaudeText gets an async-capable buildMeta; meta waits for sort + apply and carries applied ids + rows. Person entries carry sorted_at; POST /open sweeps unsorted entries older than 2 min (max 5).
D-055: Verbatim enforced in code: update text, commitment text, decision text and compass evidence quotes must be normalised substrings of the person's entry (lowercase, strip punctuation, collapse spaces) or are dropped. Caps per talk: 1 update, 2 commitments, 3 compass, 3 decisions. Talk never proposes anchor lines; the person makes one from an update ('make an anchor line').
D-056: The catch: a decision colliding with an ACTIVE refusal/non-negotiable. Sort (fast) flags candidates; MODELS.deep confirms and writes the sentence (observation, both quotes, a plain question, no order). One studio_catches row per (refusal_entry_id, person_entry_id); no second catch for the same refusal within 30 days while one is unmarked or marked right; spoken once as a companion entry with catch_id; markable right/wrong; wrong marks feed later context.
D-057: Sort categories: update, commitment, refusal, non_negotiable, drift, decision, done_commitment_ids. No win/worry/feeling labels, no valence colouring. Drift only when contradicting an active refusal/non-negotiable, both quotes kept.
D-058: Compass lifecycle = portrait pattern: pending->active (confirm; correct keeps proposed_statement), pending->rejected, active->dormant (forget, or 150 days unreinforced; drift 30 days), dormant->active (restore); reinforce RPC appends evidence; pending cap 8 (older pending -> dormant, rejection_note 'expired'); no automatic promotion of refusals.
D-059: Media privacy structural: CompanionReadable has no url/asset_id/path/swatch; DB check forbids transcript unless own_voice; reference pages never fetched; images resized client-side (1600 max edge + 480 thumb), never storage transforms.
D-060: Statuses: active, resting (trigger sets resting_until = now+14 d, refuses early wake; shown 'resting · n days left'), finished/kept/abandoned (completion_note, completed_at). Many active allowed. Resting and completed open read-only; talk still works and arrivals still land.
D-061: New project produces: title, concept revision (body + constraints), concept/since/compass blocks, ticked verbatim anchor lines, reference blocks for pasted URLs, pending compass proposals seeded from 'what will you not do' and 'what must it keep'. No draft auto-created.
D-062: Concept edited in place inside the concept block (title, body, constraints); save inserts a dated studio_concept_revisions row; the block stores nothing; bundle carries the latest revision.
D-063: Draft studio minimal: Tiptap SectionEditor + PendingEditMark, per-section lock, per-draft posture suggest|ask|locked, chat with <proposed_edit> tail hidden from the stream, anchor rail that READS live anchor blocks. No word counts, translation or publication.
D-064: studio_projects.auto_layout starts true, flips false forever on the first hand placement; while true, library additions and placed arrivals are composed into their region; heading/divider/frame are always hand-placed.
D-065: Dates lowercase '12 sep', relative via formatDateAsRelative; every generated user-facing text = COMPANION_TONE first, withLanguage() last; every model call logs usage.
D-066: Models: reply MODELS.deep 1024 (direction 2048); sort MODELS.fast 700 temperature 0; catch check MODELS.deep 300; concept draft MODELS.deep 1200; draft chat MODELS.deep 4096; punctuate as copied. Talk routes export maxDuration = 60.
D-067: Tests via tsx --test for layout, engine/{snap,viewport,commands}, talk/{verbatim,since}; npm run typecheck and npm run build must pass at the end of lane A and of every lane.
